title: Generate typography SCSS executor
description: Generates typography SCSS maps from Figma font and typescale tokens JSON files.

input.description: Path to the source font tokens JSON file, relative to the workspace root.

typescale.description: Path to the source typescale tokens JSON file, relative to the workspace root.

output.description: Path to the output SCSS file, relative to the workspace root. Defaults to `<input name>.typography.scss` next to the input.

plainVariable.description: Append ` Variable` to the plain font family name.

brandVariable.description: Append ` Variable` to the brand font family name.
